authority: Codex project coordination under user's explicit instruction to finish missing production decisions and delegate large implementation packages

lifeDecision.deathTransition: hp>0 to hp==0 only; atomic with damage+revision; record once for every damage path
lifeDecision.deathEventId: PDEATH_ + lowercase SHA256(UTF8 canonical JSON array [characterId,lifeVersion,deathRevision])
lifeDecision.deathRevision: aggregate revision immediately after the lethal damage commit
lifeDecision.lifeAdvance: each committed resurrection from hp==0 to hp>0 advances lifeVersion once; replay never advances
lifeDecision.scope: internal domain record; do not add CombatEventV2 type or fields to existing frozen wire
lifeDecision.reconnect: retain per-character death/life/receipt state across session reconnect; never derive from session ID

replay.matchedCommitted: HTTP200 same committed snapshot with applied=false,replayed=true; never heal/teleport/advance cooldown again
replay.ordering: validate request and authenticated/session ownership before receipt lookup; then committed replay before not_downed/cooldown guards
replay.newDeathSameOldKey: return old committed receipt only, no new resurrection; client must create a new intent key
replay.clientFreshRead: refresh actor/world/inventory after receipt; historical replay is not current world state

cooldown.nextReturnAllowedAtTick: successfulApplyTick+60; expose exact server tick in result/error metadata using frozen schema

gates.alphaWithPositiveRestoreHpFixture: startup validation failure; formula and fixture cannot both own HP

encounter.wipe: existing owner-scoped no-target/wipe timer rules; do not modify another owner's encounter

client.returnActionEnabled: only when server capability/private profile confirms route; handle real404 without fake success
